title: str.lstrip('abc_') strips characters, not a prefix: use removeprefix

problem.description: lstrip treats its argument as a set of characters. Python 3.9+ has str.removeprefix for prefixes.

files.check.py:
from names import strip_prefix

assert strip_prefix("abc_cab") == "cab"
assert strip_prefix("abc_x") == "x"
assert strip_prefix("zzz") == "zzz"

limitations.proves: Only the exact prefix is removed.
